items.title: TU to waive 16 types of fees for Rasuwa flood-affected students
items.summary: Kathmandu, November 22 Tribhuvan University (TU) has decided to waive fees for students displaced by the Bhotekoshi flood in Rasuwa. The waiver will apply to flood-affected students already studying in TU’s annual or semester systems, as well as those who wish to enrol newly. They will receive the waiver after the concerned local body recommends […] The post TU to waive 16 types of fees for Rasuwa

items.title: Nepal has failed disaster survivors before. Can Bhotekoshi be different?
items.summary: Past relocation schemes have left families in unsafe settlements or driven them home. A 55-year-old settlement in Kanchanpur offers lessons as the government plans to relocate Bhotekoshi flood survivors.
